title: Area 51 confirmed under the Obama administration

tellings.quote: It actually wasn't even confirmed until the Obama administration cuz the Obama administration, they wanted to expand the barriers for entry

plain: Area 51, a secret military base in the Nevada desert, was not officially admitted to exist until the Obama administration, according to the comedian and podcaster Joe Rogan. He says the government confirmed it then because "they wanted to expand the barriers for entry" around the site. If so, one of the best-known secret places in America was officially unacknowledged for decades.
